maria (runtime): Heads up — ran a targeted sweep comparing FlashAttn v2/v3 and SDPA fallbacks for causal vs non-causal at odd head-dims (hd=22,30,46). Seeing a ~12% tail-latency spike on sm80 with mixed kvcache usage. profile attached.
ajay (ml): Can you paste the minimal repro? is it only when kv-cache is warm?
dina (profiling): Quick summary: cold run qps ~ stable, warm runs after kvcache hit show several 1-2ms spikes at seq_len=1024, batch=1, head_dim=22 on v3-causal path. Trace id: trace/2026-03-12-43
maria (runtime): paste of perf table:
```
model | kernel | seq | bs | hd | p50 | p95
gpt-like | flashv3-causal | 1024 | 1 | 22 | 18.2ms | 31.4ms
gpt-like | sdpa-fallback | 1024 | 1 | 22 | 17.0ms | 27.8ms
gpt-like | flashv3-noncausal | 512 | 4 | 22 | 12.4ms | 18.1ms
```
ben (infra): Interesting — looks like kernel chooser is preferring v3-causal for hd=22 due to theoretic throughput, but real path has kvcache aliasing that kills occupancy. Can we try forcing prefetch off?
ajay (ml): I suspect head-stride alignment matters: unaligned 22 leads to vector lane waste in flashv3's tile dims. Dina — do you have perf counters (warp occupancy / l2-miss)?
dina (profiling): Yep — l2-miss rate up 3x, warp occupancy drops ~7% on the bad runs. Attached nvprof snippet.
ci-bot: perf-regression detected on branch `kernel-picker` — increase in p95 for gpt-like runs by 9% vs main. See: https://ci.internal/perf/17698
maria (runtime): Plan: 1) add a quick heuristic to prefer sdpa-fallback for head_dim % 8 != 0 when kvcache hit ratio > 0.3 and causal=true. 2) run microbench sweep across sm80/sm86 with prefetch toggles. 3) add telemetry metric for 'head_alignment' to guide autotuner. I'll open a PR shortly.
ben (infra): +1. Also add a canary rollout (10%) for the heuristic; we don't want global opt to flip unexpectedly.
ajay (ml): If you want I can craft a small eval harness to validate generation quality after fallback — to ensure no regression in outputs.
maria (runtime): Thanks — sending out PR link in a min. :shipit:
